newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 11.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 23.79 points at 6,540.05 as investors took to the sidelines ahead of Friday's March wholesale prices report.

* Indonesia's parliament on Thursday approved draft bills on local taxes and levies, taxes on the transfer of land and buildings, on the issue of warrants against tax offenders, on tax courts and on non-tax revenues, Finance Ministry officials said.
* The Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) is expected to introduce a new regulation which would limit margin trading, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index fell 2.67 points, to close at 635.56 points.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,406.00/06.40 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,406.50/07.50.
* Mining firm Inco after sharp rises on Thursday due to news reports of a share buy-back plan. Inco denied the report late on Thursday.
* Indosat on reports it planned to sell most of its stake in communications firm Satelindo.
* Bank Pikko after it was allowed to resume trading in the afternoon session on Thursday. The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading of Pikko in late trading on Tuesday.
* Bank Danamon after announcement of a rise in its 1996 net profit.
